baseline.notes: Price anchor and personal benchmark. Eligibility stays popularity within a domain; the multi-ticket deal tilts by preference (see affinity).

example/model-id.note: EXAMPLE ENTRY - replace with your own observation: one dated sentence, advisory only, shown beside the row and never reordering the ranking.

summaries.example/model-id: EXAMPLE ENTRY - replace with a research summary: what the model is known for, its caveats, every claim cited. Summaries are produced and refreshed by the summaries-refresh procedure (research/README.md).

scoring.notes: Task order = share^alpha / cost^beta (cost at the candidate's effort rung; free models priced at the pool's cheapest paid ticket). The exponent ratio decides the ordering, their scale the sharpness. Tuned 2026-10-18 against the balance thresholds across all five domains (top-1 score mass 24-47%, top-2 <= 74%): neither uniform nor dominated. Thresholds are the acceptance criterion for any coefficient change.

affinity.notes: Derivation policy for the multi-ticket deal, not stored weights: a hint's fit (favor/avoid, per domain) and evidence (validated/suspected) map to a multiplier through factors at run time. Eligibility stays popularity; the deal tilts by preference.
